title: My police AI doesn't chase where you are. It races to where you're going
author: Away_Tour1488
selftext:
Most chase AI drives at the player. Put five of those cars behind someone and you get a conga line.

I wanted the police in Wrecked District (single-player car combat) to hunt as a team instead, and it's the part of the game I've spent the most time on.

What each car does:

\- It doesn't aim at where you are. It estimates how fast it can reach where you're heading and takes the road that gets it there first.

\- The pack doesn't double up. Only a couple of cars press you directly; the rest come in from other sides and use side streets to cut you off.

\- A car commits to a ram only when it can actually get there in time. Otherwise it repositions instead of sitting on your tail.

The hard part wasn't making one car smart. It was stopping five smart cars from all making the same decision at once.

The slowed-down moments in the clip are labeled: who's pressing you and who's cutting you off. It's one real fight.

They still do something dumb now and then, and I'm still tuning. Happy to go into how any of it work
